name: Nikhman, Nikhman & Associates, PLLC
about: Nikhman, Nikhman & Associates works from Ocean Avenue in Brooklyn and practises family law alongside immigration, which its own title says. It publishes in Spanish.

100 reviews at 4.7. Its site is the fastest in this ranking, at 77 out of 100 on mobile. It names no attorney on the pages we could read, names two stages of a matrimonial case and publishes nothing about the rate or the retainer.
